narratives.Origin: Hand-authored in worktree from bound design-critique arc on https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3877 because issue:ingest refused cite-not-lean (recut body cites 5457549697 / 5457450968, ingest wants a successor-lean citation). Duplicate #3836 folded at 5457372427.
narratives.Overview: Bound contract: successor lean 5457450968, table 5457549558, synthesis 5457549697. Env-over-mint is shipped product law. Defect is two mint-path fixtures omitting an env bag. Do not sanitise the literal-acceptance runner. Guidance: hook env or --session-id, never a worker-shell export. Strengthens #3873 premise; does not close it.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Pass env: {} or empty stubEnv on the two mint-path tests. Keep env-over-mint locking tests. Update occupancy identity guidance. CHANGELOG. Do not edit the literal-acceptance runner or resolveOccupancySessionId order.
narratives.UserStory: As a worker with DEFT_SESSION_ID in the shell, I want mint-path occupancy/session tests to stay green so scope:complete and task check do not fail on an ambient variable those tests did not intend to read.
narratives.Build contract: Read lean 5457450968 and synthesis 5457549697, not the original filing presumption that fixture ids must not be overridable.
narratives.Design-critique arc: Refutation N=1. Critic 5457436628. Successor lean 5457450968. Table 5457549558. Synthesis 5457549697. Chip design-critique:triage-ready.

items.title: Isolation only: the two mint-path fixtures (occupancy.test.ts mutation session:start claims and a second session is denied; session-start-rearm.test.ts re-arm refreshes ritual without tools/triage/release/tickler) pass env: {} or empty stubEnv so they no longer read ambient process.env. Do not pin an explicit sessionId on those cases; that would silence the mint proof they exist for.

narrative.Acceptance: Both mint-path tests pass with DEFT_SESSION_ID set to an arbitrary value, without an explicit sessionId argument on those two cases.

items.title: Env-over-mint stays product law. Do not build the original filing criterion that fixture ids must not be overridable by the environment. The two locking tests (prefers DEFT_SESSION_ID over a mint; re-arm with DEFT_SESSION_ID keeps the occupant id and does not mint) still pass.

narrative.Acceptance: resolveOccupancySessionId order unchanged: explicit id, then DEFT_SESSION_ID, then mint. Locking tests green.

items.title: Do not touch the literal-acceptance runner. It inherits process.env because #3267 is verbatim. Sanitising it would green scope:complete while the same command stayed red in a worker shell.

narrative.Acceptance: defaultLiteralAcceptanceRunner still spawnSync with env: process.env. No edit to that runner.

items.title: Guidance half: occupancy identity on a host with no session derivation comes from the hook process environment or an explicit --session-id, never a worker-shell export. Nothing in content/templates or content/skills mentions DEFT_SESSION_ID (measured zero hits). Correct any prose that instructs a shell export. Do not invent an envelope mandate that does not exist.

narrative.Acceptance: Written guidance in commands.md or the freshness/occupancy docs states hook-or-explicit-id, not a shell export.
